Name: Somni's Trash Recolor - Bog Style
Author: somnifey
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FETyULb.png[/img]

Somni’s Trash Recolor – Bog Style is a full visual overhaul of the trash items in the game, created for Stardew Valley’s 10-Year ModFest using BogWyytch’s assets and palette. This recolor gives the trash items a wtichy, bog-inspired aesthetic designed to blend beautifully with a swampy game play. This is a visual-only recolor. No gameplay changes have been made.

[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pLQuz4T.png[/img]
[/code]
Recolors of the following items:[list]
[*]Trash Bag
[*]Driftwood
[*]Broken Glasses
[*]Broken CD
[*]Soggy Newspaper
[/list]
4 Themed Color Collections - view images for examples
[list]
[*]Mossgrove: Dark wood with deep green accents
[*]Duskmire: Light wood with royal purple accents
[*]Deepwater: Dark stone with ocean blue accents
[*]Bloodpeat: Dark brick with rusty red accents
[/list]
[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ggD1ojQ.png[/img]
[/code]
Trash items can appear through normal gameplay sources such as:
[list]
[*]Fishing trash catches
[*]Crab pots
[*]Trash cans around town
[/list]
[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ySnSpQ.png[/img][/code]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 compatible
[/list]
[code]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3D5bxfu.png[/img][/code]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167]Bog's Witchy Tilesheets[/url]

To keep your farm fully on-theme, consider pairing this recolor with mods from:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111]Aimon111
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/VoidWitchCult]VoidWitchCult﻿

This recolor was created during Stardew Valley’s 10-Year ModFest celebration, using BogWyytch’s assets with permission. Huge thank you for making this creative collaboration possible!
